color.note: Paper is the default theme (white page, cream cards). Navy is the evidence ground: covers, the hero, the one panel per page. A navy panel inside a paper page wraps its content in data-theme="dark".

tokens.name: brand-navy
tokens.usage: Identity navy. Headlines and bold text on paper; the ground of covers, hero bands and evidence panels.

tokens.name: brand-navy-deep
tokens.usage: Deepest navy. Text on amber fills; CTA bands and footers on navy pages.

tokens.name: brand-amber
tokens.usage: The single accent: italic headline accent, index numerals, bullets, primary button fill. 7.6:1 on navy. On paper it measures 1.8:1, so it is never body or label text there (see accent).

tokens.name: brand-seal
tokens.usage: Seal-red. The logo, alarms, broken-chain states, corner brackets. Never a decorative fill larger than the logo. 6.2:1 on white; 2.2:1 on navy, so on navy it marks, it does not carry small text.

tokens.name: brand-green
tokens.usage: Eyebrow labels on paper, verified and live states. 6.3:1 on white; 2.2:1 on navy, so never text on navy.

tokens.name: brand-cream
tokens.usage: Cream. Card fill on a white page (print); page ground on the web; headline colour on navy.

tokens.name: brand-dot
tokens.usage: The blue dot in the seal logo. Logo only; never used in layouts, links or charts.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page ground. White paper; navy on navy pages.

tokens.name: surface-alt
tokens.usage: Cards and alternating bands on surface. On the web, where the page is cream, cards flip to surface (white).

tokens.name: surface-panel
tokens.usage: The evidence panel: one navy argument per page. On navy pages it drops to navy-deep.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headlines, card titles, bold inline text, data values. 13.7:1 on surface, 12.7:1 on surface-alt (paper); 12.7:1 on navy.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Body copy and meta lines. 6.2:1 on white, 5.7:1 on cream, 5.6:1 on accent-tint; 8.7:1 on navy, 10.5:1 on navy-deep.

tokens.name: text-subtle
tokens.usage: Secondary lines (the 'typical tools' side of a comparison). Paper does not step body text down further; on navy it is 5.4:1.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines: card borders, rules, the divider above the footer. Decorative separation only; cards also differ by fill.

tokens.name: eyebrow
tokens.usage: Mono uppercase eyebrow labels. Green on paper (6.3:1 on white), amber on navy (7.6:1).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Accent marks in both themes: italic headline line, index numerals, chevrons and dots, stat numerals. On paper only at display sizes or as a non-text mark (1.8:1 on white).

tokens.name: accent-tint
tokens.usage: Callout fill ('Wat is de backend?'). ink and text read on it in both themes.

tokens.name: accent-line
tokens.usage: Callout border; the amber outline button on navy.

tokens.name: chip
tokens.usage: Small inline chip behind a status word next to a section title ('overzicht').

tokens.name: chip-ink
tokens.usage: Text on chip. 9.1:1 on paper; 10.2:1 on navy.

tokens.name: tag-ink
tokens.usage: Compliance tag text: navy on paper, amber on navy.

tokens.name: tag-line
tokens.usage: Compliance tag outline. The tag's word carries the meaning; the outline is a frame.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text on an amber fill (primary button). 9.2:1.

tokens.name: seal
tokens.usage: Alarm, tampered and broken-chain states; corner brackets; the 'them' tag in a comparison.

tokens.name: seal-tint
tokens.usage: Background of a tampered reading row.

tokens.name: seal-text
tokens.usage: A word or value that names an alarm or altered state ('Chain broken', a tampered reading). Seal-red on paper (6.2:1); cream on navy, with the red kept in the cross, border and tint.

tokens.name: verified
tokens.usage: Sealed, verified and live states: the chain diamond, the live dot, 'Live today'. On navy it is a mark (2.2:1), never small text.

tokens.name: verified-text
tokens.usage: A word that names a sealed or live state ('Chain verified', 'Live today'). Green on paper (6.3:1); on navy the word turns cream (12.7:1) and the green stays in the mark beside it.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: 2px focus outline, 3px offset. Navy on paper (13.7:1), amber on navy (7.6:1).

tokens.name: glow-amber
tokens.usage: Seal-glow: the amber radial in the top-right of navy grounds.

tokens.name: glow-green
tokens.usage: Seal-glow: the green radial in the bottom-left of navy grounds.

spacing.note: Web values from the founder page. Print spacing is in the Print section.

tokens.name: space-8

tokens.name: space-12

tokens.name: space-14

tokens.name: space-18

tokens.name: space-20

tokens.name: space-24

tokens.name: space-28

tokens.name: space-32

tokens.name: space-48

tokens.name: space-56

tokens.name: space-62
tokens.usage: Section padding on tablets and phones (860px and below).

tokens.name: space-88

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Buttons. FahCel buttons are nearly square.

tokens.name: radius-s
tokens.usage: Chain reading rows, small inline frames.

tokens.name: radius-m
tokens.usage: Web cards, panels, the comparison grid.

tokens.name: radius-l
tokens.usage: Print cards, panels and callouts on A4.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Compliance tags and chips.

tokens.name: radius-round
tokens.usage: The seal, status dots, the live dot.

shadow.note: Paper uses borders, not shadows. Shadows appear only on navy and on the amber button.

tokens.name: shadow-raised
tokens.usage: A raised card on navy (the live chain card).

tokens.name: shadow-accent
tokens.usage: Primary button at rest.

tokens.name: shadow-accent-hover
tokens.usage: Primary button on hover, with a 2px lift.

tokens.name: shadow-seal-ring
tokens.usage: Halo around the small seal disc in the header lockup.

layout.note: Breakpoints: 860px stacks grids to one column; 520px narrows gutters and brackets.

tokens.name: container
tokens.usage: Maximum content width, centred, with space-32 gutters.

tokens.name: measure-lede
tokens.usage: Maximum width of a lede paragraph.

tokens.name: measure-title
tokens.usage: Maximum width of a section title.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Every border and rule.

tokens.name: bracket-size
tokens.usage: Corner bracket arm length (18px at 520px and below).

tokens.name: bracket-stroke
tokens.usage: Corner bracket stroke weight.

tokens.name: bracket-inset
